notes: Adapted from the fork's shadow_priest/apls/p1.apl.json. Fix round 1 (stale, see the rotation-accuracy program entry below): Devouring Plague's rank was moved back to 5 (19279), not forward to spellconst's top rank 6 (19280), because sim/priest/devouring_plague.go's registration loop used to stop one rank short. Shadow Word: Death (1309636, sim/priest/shadow_word_death.go) is now implemented (rotation-accuracy program, 2026-09-28), with Forever's tier 5 Early Demise talent's below-20-percent crit bonus read through the engine's execute-phase approximation; the Mind Blast-then-Mind Flay fallback immediately beneath it stays in place for when Shadow Word: Death is still on its 15 s cooldown inside the same execute window. Shadowform is still cast at prepull, Shadow Word: Pain is maintained with the same fight-end guard as the source preset, and Inner Focus into Devouring Plague, Mind Blast on cooldown, and Mind Flay as filler are otherwise unchanged. Every rank named here is checked against the spellconst of the newest client build in builds/. Rotation-accuracy program diagnosis (2026-09-28): re-checked against the pinned engine (b7c0c36b5) -- sim/priest/devouring_plague.go's loop is `for rank := 1; rank <= DevouringPlagueRanks; rank++`, and its own git history (02a115cf7 'Devouring Plague registers its rank-6 spell at level 60') shows the off-by-one this file's Fix round 1 describes was already fixed upstream, so the earlier diagnosis is stale. The current picture is stranger, not simpler: sim/request's rewriteRotationRanks (verified directly against this file's own output at level 60) DOES rewrite every occurrence of 19279 to 19280 in the built request, so the engine is asked for rank 6 -- yet the ladder's actual level-60 run casts rank 5 (19279) instead, at a nonzero rate, never rank 6. This is not a curated-file or rewrite defect (both independently verified correct); it is reported to lane engine-melee as an open, re-opened engine finding: something in the pinned engine's spell resolution still prefers Devouring Plague's rank 5 spell object over rank 6's, despite both registering under distinct ActionIDs and the request naming rank 6 explicitly. See expected_idle below and this lane's report for the same symptom shape on Shadow Word: Death and (a different site) paladin-retribution's Seal of Command.

expected_idle.reason: Devouring Plague's authored id inside the Inner Focus strictSequence. At level 60 the rewrite correctly resolves it to rank 6 (19280, per spellranks.json's own level:60 row) and the built request names 19280 explicitly (verified directly against rewriteRotationRanks's output for this file), yet the run's actual casts land on rank 5 (19279) instead -- an engine-side spell-resolution bug, not a rotation defect; see this file's own top-level notes and this lane's report for the full diagnosis and the identical symptom on paladin-retribution's Seal of Command.

Inner Focus shares a strictSequence with Devouring Plague above. Below level 20, Devouring Plague's own rank 1 (2944) has not been learned yet (spellranks.json: level 20), so rewriteRotationRanks's all-or-nothing sequence rule (rotation_ranks.go) drops the WHOLE sequence -- Inner Focus included -- before the request is built (verified directly: rewriting this file at level 10 leaves neither 14751 nor any Devouring Plague id in the output). Inner Focus itself carries no rank chain in spellranks.json (an unranked ability, like Bloodrage/Judgement), so the ladder's own rule 1 treats it as always-learned and expects a cast the sequence-drop rule already correctly prevented at level 10 -- a harness diagnostic gap (rule 1 has no notion of 'this id's containing action was dropped because a sequence-mate's rank was unlearned', the way it already does for the zero-talent-points exemption), not a rotation defect.

Rotation-accuracy program diagnosis (2026-09-28): Shadow Word: Death is gated on isExecutePhase(E20), the same primitive paladin-retribution's Hammer of Wrath uses and that file's own expected_idle already documents as not casting on this ladder despite the window being wired correctly on the built request. This line shows the identical symptom (zero casts at every level from 38 to 60, every rank the rewrite resolves to), while warrior-fury's own Execute -- gated the same way, on the same default encounter -- does fire (20662 at level 60, 10.8% of casts). The difference between the two is not yet isolated (SW:D additionally carries its own 15s cooldown and sits behind a strictSequence-adjacent priority slot Execute does not have); reported to lane engine-melee alongside Hammer of Wrath as the same open execute-phase finding, not fixed here.

priorityList.notes: Shadow Word: Pain is kept up unless the fight is about to end, when refreshing it would waste most of the DoT.

Shadow Word: Death (sim/priest/shadow_word_death.go): Forever's tier 5 Early Demise talent gives it bonus crit chance below 20% target health, read through the engine's execute-phase approximation (isExecutePhase E20, the same primitive this line already used).
Era fallback for the execute window when Shadow Word: Death is on its own 15 s cooldown: Mind Blast on cooldown, else Mind Flay.

Inner Focus into Devouring Plague: a free, empowered cast of the priest's biggest single-target nuke. Fix round 1: rank 6 (19280, spellconst's current top rank) is excluded by an off-by-one in the engine's registration loop; rank 5 (19279) is the highest rank the engine actually registers, and the excluded rank is an engine follow-up.
Mind Flay fills every remaining global, including the rest of the execute fallback above.
